title: Hollywood and Beaches 50-Minute Helicopter Tour
blurb: Enjoy a breathtaking flight above LA on this 50 minute tour. A helicopter flight above Hollywood for an up-close view of the Hollywood Sign and Downtown L.A. Sights can include Topanga Cyn, Malibu Pier & Surfrider Beach, Santa Monica Pier, Venice Beach, Dodgers Stadium, Staples Center, Griffith Park Observatory, The Hollywood Bowl and much more!
